LanguageData.RM_Watchers_Setting_Enabled_Tip: Shy creatures (the piinnok and later members) peek out, watch you, and hide when you come near. Off: they are ordinary small animals that never hide and never turn to watch.
LanguageData.RM_Watchers_Setting_Hide_Tip: A watcher ducks out of sight when anything that is not its own kind comes close, leaving a sign on the ground where it hid. Off: they watch but never hide.
LanguageData.RM_Watchers_Setting_Face_Tip: A peeking watcher turns to face the nearest creature or person. Off: they hide but do not track you.
LanguageData.RM_Watchers_Setting_Medium_Tip: Each watcher lives on one kind of ground (the piinnok: deep sand), wanders only there, and walks back when it ends up elsewhere, tame or wild. Off: they may wander off it. Either way they only ever hide on their own ground.
LanguageData.RM_Watchers_Setting_Geophone_Tip: A piinnok hides when something large swims under the sand nearby, so a whole field going dark warns you. Needs the sand swimmers of RimMandrake: Baroque Biomes. Off: they ignore what moves underground.
LanguageData.RM_Watchers_Setting_FlushHunt_Tip: When your hunter flushes a hiding watcher, it is marked for hunting while it bolts. Off: it just runs, and you mark it yourself if you are quick.
LanguageData.RM_Watchers_Setting_CuesHeader: Other things they hide from (each creature reacts only to its own):
LanguageData.RM_Watchers_Setting_CueGas_Tip: Watchers that hide from gas (such as toxic gas from vents) go under while it hangs over them. Off: they ignore gas.
LanguageData.RM_Watchers_Setting_CueHeat_Tip: Watchers that hide from warmth go under while the ground where they sit is warmer than they can bear. Off: they ignore temperature.
LanguageData.RM_Watchers_Setting_CueFire_Tip: Watchers that hide from fire go under while a fire burns nearby, and come back up once it is out. Off: they ignore fire.
LanguageData.RM_Watchers_Setting_CueSteam_Tip: Watchers that hide from steam go under while a steam devil or vent is close. Off: they ignore steam.
LanguageData.RM_Watchers_Setting_CueShade_Tip: Shade-dwelling watchers come up only in shade (under a roof, in a cast shadow, or at night) and stay under in full sun. Off: they come up in the sun too.
LanguageData.RM_Watchers_Setting_CueBuried_Tip: Watchers that sense things buried under the ground (such as a murrek in the drift) go under while one lies nearby, so a whole patch going quiet warns you. Off: they ignore what is buried.
LanguageData.RM_Watchers_Setting_CueLight_Tip: Watchers that hide from light go under while their spot is lit (a lamp, a torch, a carried light). Off: they ignore light.

LanguageData.RM_Watchers_HuntSank: The {0} sank out of sight. You cannot hunt one where it hides: give its dimple the Flush order, and hunt it while it runs.
LanguageData.RM_Watchers_Bolts: The {0} bolts from its hiding place!
LanguageData.RM_Watchers_DesignatorFlushDesc: Mark a hiding creature's sign (a dimple in the sand) to be flushed. A hunter walks over, it bolts, and while it runs it can be hunted.
LanguageData.RM_Watchers_MustDesignateSign: Must designate the sign of a hiding creature.
